cohort: The study included 1734 patients who underwent caesarean section, stratified by gestational age into extremely preterm, very preterm, late and moderate preterm, and term groups.
finding: Antepartum hemoglobin consistently predicted PPH in all gestational age groups, while platelet count and fibrinogen were associated with PPH specifically in term and late prematurity, respectively.
gest_age: Extremely preterm (<28 weeks), very preterm (28-32 weeks), late and moderate preterm (32-37 weeks), and term (>=37 weeks)
